checks: Mainnet WETH bytecode matches the pinned block; local ETH wraps and deposits 300 wei through a real proof
noncanonical representations of an owner key cannot create fresh nullifiers for the same notes
withdrawal proof rejects changed recipient, amount, change commitment/data, unknown root and replay into another token pool
proof intent is bound to chain, pool and backing asset
an untrusted relayer executes a 120-base-unit withdrawal only to the proven recipient; double-spending is rejected
circuit rejects value in an unused input, an incorrect spending key, false input flags and a negative-value change note
the remaining change note is fully withdrawn with one active input; vault ends empty and the full 300-token deposit is recovered
note: Gas is from local EVM execution, includes the second control pool, and is not a mainnet deployment quote. No production setup, user recovery or privacy is established.
